newsitem.title: USA: ConEd NY nuke seen restarting next week.
newsitem.headline: ConEd NY nuke seen restarting next week.

text.p: Consolidated Edison Co of New York Inc's (ConEd) 975 megawatt Indian Point nuclear power unit 2 was expected to restart next week following a repair outage, a company spokeswoman said.
"It should be back on line next week," said spokeswoman Joan Burger, who declined to be more specific about the restart date.
The unit, located along the Hudson River north of New York City, was shut Jan 27 to repair problems that caused a feedwater valve to become inoperable.
ConEd was required to meet with the Nuclear Regulatory Commission, the federal group policing nuclear operations, to discuss the cause of the feedwater valve problem.
